player_prompt.intro: Udlala umdlalo wezinombolo we-Countdown! Umgomo: Hlanganisa izinombolo usebenzisa +, -, *, / ukufinyelela umgomo. Ifomethi yesenzo: [i j op] lapho i,j kuyizinombolo futhi op kungukusebenza. Isibonelo: [0 2 *] iphindaphinda inombolo enenkomba engu-0 ngenombolo enenkomba engu-2. Ukuhlukaniswa kufanele kuholele ezinombolweni eziphelele kuphela.
